summary: Gunnison Copper Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 5, 2026, announcing the launch of its 'GUNN 25 Challenge' sweepstakes—a US$25,000 cash promotion tied to the company's October 26, 2026 debut on the NYSE American under ticker GUNN. The contest runs from November 4 to December 13, 2026, with a random-drawing winner selected on or about December 16, 2026; no securities are being sold or transferred. No M&A, capital-return, or structural terms are present. What to watch: purely promotional/marketing disclosure with no deal or arbitrage angle.
